sequence_description: OIDC SSO: attempt to authenticate via enterprise OIDC SSO where the IdP omits nonce in id_token even though RP should require it when nonce was sent. Then repeat the same login to probe replay/nonce enforcement consistency.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_oidc_sso_1_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_oidc_sso_1_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: RP accepted an OIDC SSO login where the id_token omitted nonce even though nonce binding is required when nonce was sent (freshness/anti-replay failure).

sequence_description: I4 attack: attempt to cause identity collision by using empty-string sub in OIDC SSO claims and compare mapping against a normal SSO principal.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_sso_empty_sub_entity_id != user_sso_control_entity_id
Evaluation: user_sso_empty_sub_entity_id='gsynlhj9dnbv' != 'gsynlhj9dnbv' → False
Implication: Empty-sub upstream principal collapsed into the same downstream subject as a different SSO principal
